# dsh-math-copy
English | 中文

Copying rendered math from the DSH Web UI puts the formula's **LaTeX source** on
the clipboard, inst
ead of KaTeX's visual glyph text (`x2` for `x^2`).
## What it does

The Web UI renders math with KaTeX, and KaTeX keeps the original TeX source in
the formula's accessi

ers math with KaTeX, and KaTeX keeps the original TeX source in
the formula's accessibility subtree:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The browser's own selection copy walks the visible layout (and the clipped MathML
arm), so it produc

es glyph text. This plugin listens for `copy` on the document;
when the selection intersects at leas

t one formula it marks those formulas,
clones the selection, swaps each formula for its TeX wrapped

in math delimiters,
writes `text/plain` (and `text/html`) and cancels the default action. A copy
who
se selection holds no math is left completely alone.
Selecting half a formula still yields the whole formula's TeX.
## Configuration
Three fields, editable in the Plugins page:
| field | default | meaning |

| Inline formula delimiter | `"$"` | wrapped around inline math (empty → bare TeX) |
| Display formu

la delimiter | `"$$"` | wrapped around display math (empty → bare TeX) |
| Also replace the rich-tex
t flavor | `true` | substitute math in the `text/html` flavor too; off keeps the untouched selection
markup for rich paste targets |
### How the form is wired

- `index.js` declares the fields on `export const Config` and marks each one
`.volatile()`. Only vol

atile fields are projected into a form: the settings
service serves them under this entry's profile

row id, `math-copy`.
- `client.js` subscribes to that form through `ctx.configForms.get("math-copy")

`
(the same way the shipped `ui-chat` reads its preferences) and folds it over
its own defaults, so

the copy handler always reads the current values.
- The panel is registered into the `plugins.row.co

nfig` slot with the key
`<package name>#<row id>` (`dsh-math-copy#math-copy`). No shipped client
ren
ders settings forms automatically, so the plugin renders its own.

Find it at **插件 (Plugins) → dsh-math-copy → the `math-copy` row → its
configuration block**. Writes

go through the settings transport and are
persisted into the active profile's Cordis patch, so they

ttings transport and are
persisted into the active profile's Cordis patch, so they survive restarts.

Changing the host half (`index.js`) needs a **DSH restart**: the host module
generation is cached fo

r the process lifetime, and the profile's HMR entry runs
with `root: []` (no source watching). Clien

t-only edits (`client.js`) reach the
page on a reload.

Reload the Web UI page afterwards so the new client bundle enters the boot graph.

Restarting DSH after a host-half change is required — the host module generation

fter a host-half change is required — the host module generation

## Status

Developed and verified against **dsh core 0.2.0-rc.2** (DSH Desktop
2.0.15-beta.1). No `engines.dsh`

range is declared yet: the plugin uses
long-standing client services (`slots`, `locale`, `configFor

ms`, `ctx.inject`),
but only this version has actually been run, and a range that admits prerelease

builds has to name each `major.minor.patch` tuple explicitly. Declare one once
another version has b

to name each `major.minor.patch` tuple explicitly. Declare one once
another version has been tested.
## Development

`tools/asar-extract.mjs` reads Electron's `app.asar` (list or extract by path
substring) — used to r
ead the shipped client code that renders markdown and math:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`index.js` resolves `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` through the active profile when
the direct specifier

misses (a directory-installed bundle is linked into the
profile, so Node resolves its imports from t

he workspace instead). Without the
schema the plugin still copies with its built-in defaults; only t

he form is
missing. A normally installed copy (npm or GitHub, which is what
`dshmarket` performs) re

solves the direct specifier and never reaches the
fallback.
